game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Sulfur Springs Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs, steaming sulfur springs: the volcanologist must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before ember hounds spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs: steaming sulfur springs
core_gameplay_loop: In Sulfur Springs, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before ember hounds spring the trap. Each round, a new ash bricks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the predictions value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 340 points of ash bricks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 5 (applied tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predictions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ember hounds in Sulfur Springs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 340 within 34 seconds.
